reuse.why: Reuses assertBankAccountIsNotLinked, the SimpleFIN link path (parameterised by source) and generalises the Akahu downloader into downloadProviderTransactions; the near-identical Pluggy downloader is left as its own copy.

duplication.why: Adds no copied logic: link and download both go through shared functions; only the existing Pluggy/Akahu download duplication is half-resolved.

placement.why: Linking stays in accounts/app.ts, downloading in sync.ts and the base path in server-config, matching the other providers; but Fintegra linking lives inside a function named for SimpleFIN.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the downloader generalisation is a related refactor needed to avoid a copy.

maintainability.why: linkSimpleFinAccount now silently serves two providers through a source flag, a union type and an 'orgDomain' in externalAccount probe, which a maintainer of SimpleFIN could break without noticing; a provider-neutral name or helper would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The duplicate-link check, account linking and transaction download all go through the existing shared functions.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; Fintegra delegates to shared functions rather than copying them.
